nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) _tOwned: token-denominated balances for excluded accounts
bool inSwapAndLiquify: swap reentrancy guard flag
bool swapAndLiquifyEnabled: master switch for auto liquidity
address _owner: contract owner used by onlyOwner
_transfer(address,address,uint256): core transfer logic with blacklist, maxTx and swap triggers
swapAndLiquify(uint256): swaps tokens and adds liquidity, guarded by lockTheSwap
swapTokensForEth(uint256): router swap of token to ETH
sendETHToMarketing(uint256): raw ETH transfer to marketing wallet
_tokenTransfer(address,address,uint256,bool): dispatches to the four reflection transfer variants
_getValues(uint256): computes r and t amount tuples
_getCurrentSupply(): loops over _excluded to derive current supplies
setMaxTxPercent(uint256): owner sets maxTxAmount via mul/div
recoverTokens(uint256): owner pulls tokens held by the contract
manualSwap(): owner-triggered router swap of contract balance
manualSend(): owner-triggered ETH send to marketing
deliver(uint256): burns reflection from caller and accrues fees
balanceOf(address): view balance resolving excluded accounts
reflection rate arithmetic (mul/div by rate) in _getTValues/_getRValues/_getRate
